bands.learnH: Learn by doing, not by reading.
bands.learnB: Complete fun missions, interactive lessons and real-life scenarios to build money skills step by step. Missions stay inside WiseCub — virtual coins only.
bands.marketH: A real market. Fake money. No regrets.
bands.marketB: Explore the virtual stock market, practise trades, and build your own portfolio with pretend rupees.
bands.safeH: We send the scam, so no one else has to.
bands.safeB: Try realistic scam scenarios and learn how to identify and avoid fraud in a safe space. WiseCub never sends real messages.
bands.sms: Congratulations! You have won Rs. 50,000. This is a fake drill.
bands.choiceB: Explore different life paths and see how your education, spending and saving choices can shape your future.
bands.buddyH: Ask Cub in English, Sinhala, or Singlish.
bands.buddyB: Tap Ask Cub at the bottom-right on any page after login. Cub can explain pages and open allowed rooms. Pretend money only.
bands.buddyHi: Hey! I'm WiseCub. Ask me anything about money, investing or staying safe.
bands.parentH: See progress, not just screen time.
bands.parentB: Track learning progress, completed missions and key skills. Habit notes — never a profit rank.
bands.footH: A brighter, safer financial future starts with you.
bands.footP: WiseCub · Small steps today, bigger dreams tomorrow.
